toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Met behulp van' is the natural Afrikaans expression; 'die sterre se hulp' reads as if the stars actively helped.
toegepas.fout: 'met die sterre se hulp' is a loose phrasing that makes the stars sound like active helpers
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Met behulp van die sterre' is the fixed Afrikaans expression for using something as an aid, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: het baie van Egipte se kuns en bouwerk gehou
toegepas.na: het baie gehou van Egipte se kuns en bouwerk
toegepas.rede_vinder: In the original order 'baie van Egipte se kuns' can be misread as 'much of Egypt's art'; moving the phrase after 'gehou' removes the ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: 'het baie van Egipte se kuns en bouwerk gehou' can be read first as 'kept much of Egypt's art' (hou = keep)
toegepas.rede_keurder: Moving 'van' next to its object makes 'hou van' (liked) unambiguous, keeps 'baie', and the people and action stay the same.

toegepas.voor: Dit is ook kennis en idees.
toegepas.na: Dit sluit ook kennis en idees in.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit is ook kennis en idees' is wooden; 'sluit ... in' says naturally that the legacy includes knowledge and ideas.
toegepas.fout: 'Dit is ook kennis en idees' is flat and slightly wooden after the previous sentence
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Dit sluit ook kennis en idees in' says naturally that the legacy includes knowledge and ideas, with the same meaning and the protected words untouched.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Voortbou op' is the idiomatic verb for building further on what was learnt; plain 'bou' reads literally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'daarop bou' is already natural, plain Afrikaans for a Grade 5 reader; 'voortbou' only reads differently.

laat_vaar.voor: was dit sowat 3 800 jaar gelede die begin van die vroegste alfabet
laat_vaar.na: was dit die begin van die vroegste alfabet, sowat 3 800 jaar gelede
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The time phrase wedged between 'dit' and 'die begin' makes the sentence hard to follow; placing it at the end reads naturally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Time before the predicate is normal Afrikaans word order and the original reads correctly; the proposal is a lateral reorder.

laat_vaar.voor: Daaruit kom die Griekse letters en later ook ons letters.
laat_vaar.na: Daaruit het die Griekse letters ontstaan en later ook ons letters.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Present-tense 'kom' clashes with 'later' in a past-tense account; 'het ... ontstaan' keeps the tense consistent.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Daaruit kom' is a natural present-tense statement of origin, and the proposal leaves 'en later ook ons letters' dangling after the participle, so it is not clearly better.

na_skrywer.voor: Ons kalender vandag kom daarvan af.
na_skrywer.na: Ons kalender van vandag stam daarvan af.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Daarvan afkom' can also mean 'get rid of it'; 'stam daarvan af' says unambiguously that it descends from it, and 'van vandag' is the usual form.
na_skrywer.fout: 'kom daarvan af' can also mean 'gets rid of it', and 'ons kalender vandag' is a loose form
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: 'stam daarvan af' says plainly that our calendar descends from it, and 'van vandag' is the natural form; the claim is unchanged.
na_skrywer.waarom: not applied: it changes the protected wording 'kom', which must stay as it is; fix the fault without changing those words

na_skrywer.voor: waarin elke teken vir 'n klank staan
na_skrywer.na: waarvan elke letter vir 'n klank staan
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Letters waarin elke teken' mixes two nouns and the wrong relative; 'waarvan elke letter' refers cleanly back to the letters.
na_skrywer.fout: 'n Stel letters waarin elke teken' mixes two nouns and the relative 'waarin' reads as signs inside letters
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a glossary definition, and the fix rewords it beyond a plain grammar correction (teken to letter), so the writer must decide it across lessons.
